Differences between two snapshots

Source: R/snapshot-diff.R
markermd_snapshot_diff.Rd

S7 class returned by snapshot_diff(): the rubric, marks, score and template changes between two snapshots, or between a snapshot and the live state. Its print method groups the changes by question.

Usage

markermd_snapshot_diff(
  from = character(0),
  to = character(0),
  from_label = character(0),
  to_label = character(0),
  rubric = (function (.data = list(), row.names = NULL) 
 {
     if (is.null(row.names))
    {
         list2DF(.data)
     }
     else {
         out <- list2DF(.data,
    length(row.names))
attr(out, "row.names") <- row.names
         out
     }

    })(),
  marks = (function (.data = list(), row.names = NULL) 
 {
     if (is.null(row.names))
    {
         list2DF(.data)
     }
     else {
         out <- list2DF(.data,
    length(row.names))
attr(out, "row.names") <- row.names
         out
     }

    })(),
  scores = (function (.data = list(), row.names = NULL) 
 {
     if (is.null(row.names))
    {
         list2DF(.data)
     }
     else {
         out <- list2DF(.data,
    length(row.names))
attr(out, "row.names") <- row.names
         out
     }

    })(),
  totals = (function (.data = list(), row.names = NULL) 
 {
     if (is.null(row.names))
    {
         list2DF(.data)
     }
     else {
         out <- list2DF(.data,
    length(row.names))
attr(out, "row.names") <- row.names
         out
     }

    })(),
  template = (function (.data = list(), row.names = NULL) 
 {
     if
    (is.null(row.names)) {
         list2DF(.data)
     }
     else {
         out <-
    list2DF(.data, length(row.names))
attr(out, "row.names") <- row.names
      
      out
     }
 })()
)

Arguments

from

Character. The "from" side's snapshot id.

to

Character. The "to" side's snapshot id, or "current".

from_label

Character. A short description of the "from" side.

to_label

Character. A short description of the "to" side.

rubric

Data frame of rubric changes (question, change, item, detail): items added, removed, reworded, re-pointed or regrouped, group and scoring changes, questions added or removed.

marks

Data frame of marks changes (repo, question, change, before, after): pairs whose selections, public comment or private note changed.

scores

Data frame of score changes per pair (repo, question, before, after, change).

totals

Data frame of every repository's total (repo, before, after, change).

template

Data frame of template changes (question, change, detail).

Value

A markermd_snapshot_diff S7 object.

See also

snapshot_diff()
